mapper.select: SELECT type.id as serve_type_id, type.img as serve_type_img, type.name as serve_type_name, type.sort_num as serve_type_sort_num FROM serve INNER JOIN serve_item item ON item.id = serve.serve_item_id INNER JOIN serve_type type ON type.id = item.serve_type_id WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND serve.sale_status = 2 ORDER BY serve_type_sort_num ASC
